steps: Parathormone increases blood calcium, Calcitonin decreases it; they are antagonistic.
Insulin decreases blood glucose, Glucagon increases it; they are antagonistic.
Aldosterone increases sodium reabsorption, ANF decreases blood pressure/sodium; they are antagonistic.
Relaxin acts on pelvic ligaments during childbirth, Inhibin inhibits FSH secretion; they have no antagonistic relationship.
